title: Règne Delta is out in 4 days: Friday 6 November
detail: Worldwide release on 6 Nov; the online game (Pokémon TCG Live) gets it a day earlier, on 5 Nov. Mega Rayquaza ex is the headliner, with Mega Malamar ex and six Stadium cards. The English card list was still partly unofficial in the sources I found, so treat extra card details with caution.

title: Miyata Kard Market shows the 6 Nov date, but no Règne Delta products or prices yet
detail: Its home page carries a Règne Delta banner for 06/11/2026. No displays, boosters or stock were listed when I checked this morning. Ask the shop directly about allocations. Sortilèges' site had an expired security certificate, so I couldn't read it.

title: OP-18 release date is still unclear: 21 or 22 November in Japan
detail: One source says 21 Nov, a post on the official X account says 22 Nov. Unconfirmed until Bandai's site lists it. The official card database had no OP-18 cards as of 7 Oct, and pack price (¥240) comes from secondary sources only. The Calendar still shows 21 Nov.

title: Regionals in Porto and Sydney this Saturday, 7 November
detail: Still the first big events since the Mihawk ban. Nothing has finished since yesterday, so no new results yet.

title: No price checks today
detail: The TCGdex card data returned no Cardmarket prices this morning, so I could not compare 7-day and 30-day averages. Yesterday's movers still stand. I'll retry tomorrow.
